description: Use when a control opens hidden UI: adds a sized, linked dropdown, side, sheet, dialog or state board beside its screen.

kind.description: dropdown, side, sheet, dialog, or state (a tab, a segment, the result after Send).

screen.description: The screen the control is on (index, id or name).

to.description: Instead of kind: the screen a tab or Continue goes to (links it; no board).

trigger.description: {shape_ids} or {label}: the control that opens it.

name: add_hidden_ui
title: Add hidden UI
